newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Grand Orient proposes bonus warrants.
newsitem.headline: Grand Orient proposes bonus warrants.

text.p: Grand Orient Holdings Ltd said on Monday it had proposed a bonus issue of 110.2 million warrants in the proportion of one warrant for every five shares held.
The warrants will carry the right to subscribe one new company share at an initial subscription price of HK$2.05 each between May 19, 1997, and May 18, 2000, it said.

The company said about 110.2 million new shares, or 16.7 percent of the enlarged share capital, would be issued on full conversion of the warrants, bringing the total number of shares in issue to 661.17 million shares.
"The bonus issue will provide shareholders of the company with an immediate benefit and an opportunity for the company to strengthen its financial position," it said in the statement.
Grand Orient said the register of shareholders would be closed from May 12-14.
The company's shares were HK$0.04 lower at HK$1.91 in mid-morning trade.
